svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json # After Google's Cloud Architecture Center reference for a RAG-capable generative AI application # on Vertex AI (now Agent Platform) and AlloyDB for PostgreSQL: an ingestion subsystem that turns # uploaded documents into embeddings, and a serving subsystem that grounds Gemini in them. title: Retrieval-augmented generation on Google Cloud subtitle: Cloud Run embeds documents into AlloyDB with Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) and retrieves them to ground Gemini answers direction: down # Product cards, as in Google Cloud's own architecture diagrams; one port per edge. look: card layout: { merge: false } legend: solid: Requests and data dashed: Ingestion events groups: gcloud: { type: gcp:cloud } project: { type: gcp:project, label: Project rag-prod, in: gcloud } region: { type: gcp:region, label: us-central1, in: project } # Serving runs down the left, ingestion down the right, and the two meet at the models and # the vector store. Agent Platform services draw the Vertex AI core icon. nodes: users: { icon: generic:users, label: Users, note: Chat app in the browser } frontend: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Cloud Run, note: frontend service, in: region } backend: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Cloud Run, note: backend service, in: region } # Level with the ingestion job, between the two columns, so neither flow crosses the other. embed: { icon: gcp:vertex-ai, label: Embeddings API, note: Agent Platform, in: region, align: job } bucket: { icon: gcp:cloud-storage, label: Cloud Storage, note: Source documents, in: region } topic: { icon: gcp:pubsub, label: Pub/Sub, note: Upload notifications, in: region } job: { icon: gcp:cloud-run, label: Cloud Run job, note: Chunk and embed, in: region } gemini: { icon: gcp:vertex-ai, label: Gemini, note: Agent Platform, in: region } alloydb: { icon: gcp:alloydb, label: AlloyDB for PostgreSQL, note: Vector store with ScaNN index, in: region, rank: last } edges: - users -> frontend: HTTPS - frontend -> backend: question - backend -> embed: embed question - backend -> alloydb: vector search - backend -> gemini: prompt and context - bucket --> topic: object finalized - topic --> job: trigger - job -> embed: chunks - job -> alloydb: write embeddings

svg.title: Retrieval-augmented generation on Google Cloud
svg.desc: Retrieval-augmented generation on Google Cloud. 9 components in 3 groups. Connections: Users to Cloud Run (HTTPS); Cloud Run to Cloud Run (question); Cloud Run to Embeddings API (embed question); Cloud Run to AlloyDB for PostgreSQL (vector search); Cloud Run to Gemini (prompt and context); Cloud Storage to Pub/Sub (object finalized); Pub/Sub to Cloud Run job (trigger); Cloud Run job to Embeddings API (chunks); Cloud Run job to AlloyDB for PostgreSQL (write embeddings).

text.tspan: Cloud Run embeds documents into AlloyDB with Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI) and retrieves them to ground Gemini answers
